scope: Single Arizona 2026 SCR 1023 Senate Third Reading aggregate, checked against official Arizona House legislative staff bill summary and Senate third-reading calendar. Not a member-level roll-call roster or statewide legislative inventory.

records.limitations: The official House legislative staff summary reports Senate Third Read 16-13-1-0; official Senate March 9 calendar lists SCR 1023 for third reading. This confirms aggregate counts, not member-by-member votes or final enactment.

warning: Only the named motion is official-aggregate crosschecked; all other secondary vote references remain unverified. No zero placeholder becomes a 0-0 vote.
